description: This file defines the ResultPaginator class in the AWS SDK for PHP, which provides an iterator interface for paginating through multi-page API responses. It includes methods for asynchronously handling paginated results, applying search expressions, and managing pagination tokens.

classes.name: ResultPaginator
classes.description: An iterator class that manages pagination over AWS SDK responses, supporting synchronous and asynchronous iteration, token management, and applying JMESPath search expressions on results.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new ResultPaginator instance with the client, operation, arguments, and configuration.

methods.name: each
methods.description: Runs the paginator asynchronously, invoking a callback with each result page, and managing promise merging.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Returns an iterator applying a JMESPath search expression to each result.

methods.name: current
methods.description: Returns the current result or false if invalid.

methods.name: key
methods.description: Returns the current request count index or null.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Advances the iterator by clearing the current result.

methods.name: valid
methods.description: Checks if the current page/result is valid, handling pagination and token logic.

methods.name: rewind
methods.description: Resets the paginator to the initial state.

methods.name: createNextCommand
methods.description: Creates the next command with the combined args and next token.

methods.name: determineNextToken
methods.description: Determines the next pagination token based on the result and configuration.
